title: Craftable Backpacks
body: CRAFT BACKPACK IRON (15 items: Sturdy Oak Log + Iron Ingot) | STEEL (30 items: Ironwood Log + Steel Ingot) | CHAKRA (50 items: Ancient Heartwood Log + Chakra Steel Ingot). Bukijutsu level 25+ may craft all three; other classes level 100+ may craft Iron only. PUT <item> IN BACKPACK and GET <item> FROM BACKPACK to store/retrieve; BACKPACK <name> inspects contents, BACKPACK lists capacity. Empty your backpack before transferring or dropping it. Nested containers are disallowed.
